cd /root/trace-verdict-study/docs/paper && python3 -c "
import subprocess
pdf = 'main.pdf'
for p in range(1, 25):
    r = subprocess.run(['pdftotext', '-f', str(p), '-l', str(p), pdf, '-'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if not r.stdout.strip():
        break
    lines = [l.strip() for l in r.stdout.split('\n') if l.strip()]
    first = lines[0][:80] if lines else ''
    last = lines[-1][:80] if lines else ''
    print(f'Page {p}: first={first} | last={last}')
    for kw in ['Conclusion', 'Limitations', 'References', 'Appendix']:
        if kw in r.stdout:
            print(f'  >>> {kw} on page {p}')
"
